findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_invoice, open_invoice_check · Private data: validate_invoice, generate_invoice, convert_invoice, extract_invoice, open_invoice_check, get_service_status, get_pricing_and_limits · Public sink: open_invoice_check · Destructive: validate_invoice, convert_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_invoice, open_invoice_check · Private data: validate_invoice, generate_invoice, convert_invoice, extract_invoice, open_invoice_check, get_service_status, get_pricing_and_limits · Public sink: open_invoice_check · Destructive: validate_invoice, convert_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
